name: Amira Learning
tagline: AI reading tutor that listens to K-12 students read aloud and coaches in real time.
description: Amira is an AI-powered reading assistant that listens to students read aloud, assesses fluency, flags errors, and delivers one-on-one tutoring in real time — combining dynamic assessment, lesson planning, and tutoring in a single system. Grounded in the science of reading and used by school districts across more than 15 countries, it offers an English/Spanish bilingual edition (Amira Lectura).
insight: Its reading-science + AI tech traces to 1990s Carnegie Mellon research; Amira is now used by 2M+ students across 15+ countries.
edge: Speech-based: students read aloud and Amira coaches pronunciation and fluency live, where most ed-AI tutors only handle text and quizzes, not oral reading.

references.title: Meet Amira, the AI tutor helping Louisiana students improve reading
